name: poeltlback
caption:
BOOMERANG 🎮🏀 We drafted Jakob Poeltl. Traded him for Kawhi. Then traded to get him back.

• 2016 draft: we take him #9, the first Austrian ever drafted
• July 2018: he goes to San Antonio with DeMar DeRozan, Kawhi comes to us
• Feb 2023: we send a first-round pick to bring him back
• 2025: 4-year, $104M extension
• First 10 games this season: 8.3 PPG, 6.6 RPG, 19 and 11 at Milwaukee

Worth a first to bring him back? 👇

beats.head: PICK 9
beats.name: POELTL
beats.vo: We drafted Jakob Poeltl. Then we traded him for Kawhi Leonard.
beats.dlg: 2016: WE DRAFT POELTL #9.|2018: TRADED FOR KAWHI.

beats.head: THE KAWHI TRADE
beats.name: POELTL
beats.vo: He went to San Antonio with DeMar DeRozan. Kawhi came to us, and we won a title.
beats.dlg: POELTL + DEMAR TO SPURS.|KAWHI COMES TO US.

beats.head: BACK HOME
beats.name: POELTL
beats.vo: Five years later, we sent a first-round pick to San Antonio to bring him back.
beats.dlg: FEB 2023: WE SEND A 1ST...|TO BRING HIM BACK.

beats.head: THIS SEASON
beats.name: POELTL
beats.vo: Through ten games this season: six point six rebounds on sixty-two percent shooting. And nineteen and eleven in our win at Milwaukee.
beats.dlg: FIRST 10 GAMES: 6.6 RPG.|19 AND 11 AT MILWAUKEE.

beats.head: WORTH IT?
beats.vo: Was he worth a first-round pick to bring back? Comment below.
beats.dlg: WORTH A FIRST TO|BRING HIM BACK?

facts.claim: June 23, 2016: Poeltl selected #9 (ninth overall) by Toronto, first Austrian drafted; July 18, 2018: traded with DeMar DeRozan to the San Antonio Spurs for Kawhi Leonard and Danny Green; after 5 seasons, February 9, 2023: traded back to Toronto for Khem Birch, a 2024 first-round (1st) pick and two second-round picks; July 2025: 4-year, $104 million extension
